name: LeGoTDP
author: Rayek
description: Set AMD CPU TDP limits directly from the Steam overlay on the Lenovo Legion Go 2 and Legion Go S. Preset ladders spaced against each machine's own firmware ceilings, custom sliders, per-game profiles with separate battery and charging limits, and live power draw read from RAPL.

name: LeGo Vibe Control
author: Rayek
description: Control vibration intensity and mode on the Lenovo Legion Go and Legion Go 2. Five rumble patterns, per-game profiles, and touchpad haptics. Uses the hid-lenovo-go kernel driver (Kernel 6.18+ / SteamOS 3.8+) and persists settings across reboots. The Legion Go S is not supported: its driver does not expose vibration control.

name: LeGo2 Brightness Fix
author: Rayek
description: Two display fixes for the Lenovo Legion Go 2 OLED under gamescope. Makes the Steam brightness slider work again while the panel runs in HDR/PQ, where the panel ignores the backlight and nothing downstream listens. Also drops the DisplayID block from the EDID gamescope hands to games, which DXVK's vendored parser rejects outright - without it games fall back to a 1499 nit placeholder and generic primaries instead of the panel's real values. Both halves stand down automatically whenever they are not needed.

name: Decky Vibrance HDR
author: Rayek
description: Saturation control for both SDR and HDR content under gamescope. SDR uses gamescope's own gamut wideness dial; HDR has no such dial, so the plugin generates a colour LUT and hands it to gamescope's HDR look slot. The HDR adjustment is computed in ICtCp, so raising saturation does not drag lightness or hue along with it.
